english.note: Use this for the nerve or audacity to do something outrageous, especially in phrases like 有咁嘅膽.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for courage or nerve, especially in phrases like having the guts to do something.

examples.english: You really have the gall to yell at the boss.
examples.traditional: 你真係有咁嘅膽，竟然夠膽鬧老闆。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 gam3 ge3 daam2 ging2 jin4 gau3 daam2 naau6 lou5 baan2

examples.english: You really have the guts to go into that haunted house alone.
examples.traditional: 你真係有膽，敢一個人去闖嗰間鬼屋。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 daam2 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 cam3 go2 gaan1 gwai2 uk1
